messages.subject: Light-House Board 1900: the pages you asked for
messages.snippet: Eight page images, straight scans from the bound annual report for the year ended 30 June 1900.
messages.body:
Marion,

The eight page images that came over with your brief are straight scans from the bound annual report of the Light-House Board for the fiscal year ended 30 June 1900. They were made at the reading room table this week and nothing has been cleaned up, straightened or retyped, so a few figures sit close to the gutter and one or two lines are heavy. Read them as they are.

Six of the eight carry entries of the kind you are after. The other two are there only because you asked for the pages either side of a district break, and they carry nothing that belongs in a money return.

The front matter is in the folder as well so the committee can see which volume the pages come from. The volume itself cannot leave the building and will not be rephotographed, so these scans are the only copy you are going to get.

Hesper

messages.subject: Small grants round closes 12 September
messages.snippet: The autumn small grants round is open for applications from record trusts.
messages.body:
Dear colleague,

The autumn small grants round is open. Awards run from two thousand to twelve thousand dollars and are made for cataloguing and conservation work only. Applications close on 12 September.

The Harbour Foundation
